label: Photographer / Photography studio
description: Portrait, wedding and event photography. Clients pick a package, pay a deposit to hold a date, then the session is confirmed.

terminology.capacity_rule: one session per date by default

flow_notes: After picking a date, ask which package style they want, then show the live rate card via agent_get_ratecard.
State the deposit plainly: half the package price, paid online to hold the date.
Deliverables and add-ons (albums, extra hours, second shooter) come from the rate card add-ons, never invented.

faq_seed.question: How many photos do we receive?
faq_seed.answer: Depends on the package; the full deliverables list is on each package in the rate card.

faq_seed.question: Do you travel for shoots?
faq_seed.answer: Yes, travel is quoted per location; ask for the location before quoting.

faq_seed.question: How long until photos are delivered?
faq_seed.answer: Editing takes a few weeks depending on the package; confirm the current timeline before promising.
